sources.title: xbill9/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-qat-q4_0-w4a16-ct · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Google publishes compressed-tensors W4A16 QAT checkpoints for Gemma 4 E2B, E4B, 12B and 31B. Its QAT model card lists none for 26B-A4B, which ships as Q4_0 GGUF and as a 48 GiB bf16 export.

sources.title: gemma 4 E2B it qat w4a16 ct by Google — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: A compact, quantized variant of Google's Gemma 4 family, running at 4-bit weights with 16-bit activations (W4A16). The quantization makes it notably leaner in memory footprint compared to its full-precision counterparts, with the typical trade-off of slight accuracy degradation in exchange for faster inference and lower hardware requirements.
